0022600109.text: The Spurs (0-2, 12th in the West and 5th in the Southwest) visit the Mavericks (1-1, 9th in the West and 3rd in the Southwest) for their third game of the 2026-27 season, and both of San Antonio's losses have come at home. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), while Dallas is missing Cooper Flagg (shoulder, soreness) and Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), with Caleb Martin, Jett Howard, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Spurs won all four matchups in 2025-26, most recently a 139-120 victory in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
